LanguageData.BOR_Canter.label: canter
LanguageData.BOR_Canter.description:
A clean and sterile name for what is effectively the lovechild of Adrenaline, Yayo, and Hyper-Caffeinated Energy Drinks. Canter nullifies pain and pushes the user's physical abilities to their limit. Due to the lax regulations surrounding Kwazaari Food and Drug Sales addictive chemicals are key parts in several compounds that compose the drug, presumably to boost sales.
"There are those who can't, and those who Canter." -Promotional Advertisement
